quest.title: An Invitation From the Spark Knight
quest.description: Klee seems to be looking for you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Fish-Flavored Toast x5, Guide to Freedom x3

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Amber told me that there's gonna be a race here, and loads of other cool activities.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I'm having the best time. The nice people running the stalls gave me loads and loads of gifts to take home with me.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Here, have this snowman. I won it from one of the games.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: If you ever have some free time, we should go play it together!
